item.title: Atmospheric river and high freezing level: record rain, river rises and isolation from Biobío to Los Ríos [22-25 September 2026]
item.description: Rainfall and streamflow observations explain how the frontal system isolated 4,606 people and damaged thousands of homes from Biobío to Los Ríos.
